title: Part - Time Instructor, JUMPSTART - Economics - 2027
description:
Part - Time Instructor, JUMPSTART - Economics - 2027



Job Description

CSN is seeking part-time instructors to teach Economics courses
through the CSN Jumpstart Program at a Clark County School District
(CCSD) high school. Teaching assignments will include college-level
Economics courses delivered through the Jumpstart Program.

Core Responsibilities


Prepare lectures and course materials.

Develop exams, quizzes, and other assessment activities.

Evaluate student learning and mastery of course outcomes.

Participate in course and program assessment activities for
accreditation and other purposes.




Required Qualifications


Applicants must be pre-approved by the social sciences
department and the Jumpstart Program before submitting an
application in Workday.

Must have at least a Master's degree in economics from a
regionally accredited college or university and at least 18
graduate credits in the subject being taught (from a regionally
accredited college or university).




Salary

$1,000.00 per class, per semester. Courses/Credits assigned may
vary by semester.

Applications will be considered on an as-needed basis determined
by course availability.

Exempt

Yes

Full-Time Equivalent

48.8%

Required Attachment(s)

To be considered for this position, candidates must attach the
following documents:


Resume/CV

Cover Letter

Unofficial Transcript
